traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Gullibility and wishful thinking mistaken for reality. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for growth against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the growth/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: Excess and overreach collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: A compelling idea can keep pulling more time, money, or confidence out of you long after the practical evidence has stopped supporting it.
readerCopy.body: A compelling idea can keep pulling more time, money, or confidence out of you long after the practical evidence has stopped supporting it. When Jupiter squares Neptune, enthusiasm can fill in the parts of a plan that have never been properly tested, making optimism feel like proof that the missing structure will somehow appear later. If the same questions about cost, delivery, responsibility, or results keep going unanswered, take that seriously. You do not have to abandon the vision, but you do need to stop asking belief to carry the part that only a workable plan can support.
